If you choose a surface, the glyph can cover an area of the surface no larger than 10-feet in diameter. For chakra seals inscribed within an object, the most common triggers include opening that object, approaching within a certain distance of the object, or seeing or reading the seal. Once a chakra seal is triggered, it explodes in a 15-foot radius sphere, destroying the surface it is inscribed on, Creatures in radius must make a Dexterity saving throw taking 10d6+10 Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Afterwards the jutsu ends.

Rank: C-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: 5 feet Duration: 10 minutes
Components: HS, CM, CS Cost: Special (10 Chakra) Keywords: Ninjutsu, Fire Release, Fuinjutsu Description: You take a chakra seal and imprint your chakra onto it, before attempting to bind it to a creature, forcing them to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target creature is branded with a flaming chakra seal for the duration. While branded with this seal, creatures have extreme difficulty molding chakra. When the affected creature would cast a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu with the Chakra Molding (CM) component, They must make a Chakra Control check at disadvantage vs your Ninjutsu save DC. On a failure, they take 5d8 Fire damage. Creatures can make a Ninshou skill check as an action vs your Ninjutsu save DC to break the seal ending this jutsu.

Rank: B-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: Self Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes.
Components: HS, CM Cost: 14 Chakra Keywords: Ninjutsu, Fire Release Description: Flames race across your body, shedding bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet for the Jutsu’s duration. The flames don’t harm you or any allied creature. Until the jutsu ends, you gain the following benefits:
You are immune to Fire & wind damage.
Resistant to Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

A creature takes 3d10+3 Fire damage and gains the Burned condition on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

rules.text: Combination: a creature dead no more than 10 minutes wakes with full hit points and chakra for 1 minute; its jutsu become Fire Release; its damage is fire and ignores resistance (immunity as resistance); then it turns to ash (10+ casters: a DC 20 Constitution save to survive).

jutsuBookImport.sourceText:
Rank: A-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action. Range: Touch Duration: 1 Minute
Components: HS, CM Cost: Special (95 Chakra) Keywords: Ninjutsu, Fire Release, Medical, Combination Description: You and all other casters, touch a creature who has been dead no longer than 10 minutes, infusing its body with Fire Release chakra, giving it a temporary spark of life fueled by you.
The creature awakes with full Hit points and Chakra points. All jutsu they cast lose any other Nature Release Keywords and Gain the Fire Release Keyword in its place.
All Class, or Clan features that would require a nature release keyword of any type works with Jutsu with the Fire release keyword. All damage they deal is counted as Fire damage and ignores resistance, and treats immunity as resistance instead.
At the end of the 1-minute duration or if the creatures hit points is reduced to 0, they turn to ash as that spark of life goes out being unable to be revived by any means.
Combination: Increase the revived creatures maximum hit points by +10, for every additional creature aiding in casting this jutsu, beyond the first two. If 10 or more creatures participate in this jutsu’s casting, the affected creature is allowed to make a single DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a success, they do not turn to ash, and are able to remain alive after this jutsu’s 1 minute duration. On a failure, they turn to ash as normal.
